correctionOf: The initial review projected only pass-94 R1-R11 and omitted R4, R12, R13 and R14, then asserted no loss. That assertion was false. This file enumerates ALL 22 original IDs, one entry per ID, read directly from the manifests at 089cb13.

dispositions.PROJECT: The obligation remains live at the active candidate and is carried into acceptance/pass-96.json.
dispositions.SUPERSEDED: A later owner instruction or a later published pass replaced this obligation's target. The record is archived verbatim; only the retained invariant (if any) is projected.
dispositions.HISTORICAL: The obligation was scoped to a past contribution or past publication event and does not restate as a live obligation. Archived verbatim. Any durable invariant it protected is named and projected separately.

processClauseRule: A process-scoped restriction on a past diff (for example pass-94 R3 'only the spawn declaration changes') is NOT an indefinite ban on future geometry work. Such clauses are preserved as historical, and only the retained PRODUCT invariant is projected. This is recorded per ID in historicalClause.
